claim: The pinned GS101 build produces the kernel plus the external Wi-Fi, SysMMU and CPIF modules required by the Pixel 6 hardware journey.
oracle: A Linux build resolves the Nura-based configuration, compiles Image and the Oriole DTB, builds bcmdhd.ko, samsung-iommu.ko and cpif.ko, installs their matching module tree and records hashes. No hardware-ready claim follows from this build alone.

user_journey.scenario: Recover the unresponsive diagnostic phone, then boot a matching kernel/modules set into Omarchy and exercise GPU, Wi-Fi, SIM and cameras.
user_journey.expected: No missing-driver regression; staged hardware checks and slot-A recovery remain required.

invariants: Use exact pinned kernel and Nura commits
Parse the reference configuration as data, never source APKBUILD
External modules are built explicitly; olddefconfig does not retain their unrelated Kconfig symbols
No firmware, credentials or device partitions enter the build
gitnexus: Unavailable in this session; direct inspection of APKBUILD prepare/build/package and the CI workflow establishes the call boundaries.
ast: G15 output must not pre-exist; unknown MMU content must be rejected.

unit.red: The old workflow gives apply-gpu-g15 an existing mktemp file, starts from arm64 defconfig and omits all external-module builds.
unit.green: Literal config/parser merge tests, public-source suite and G15 actual-C failure injection passed; CLI output preservation also passed.

boundaries: pinned sources -> 38 patches -> configuration -> compiler -> installed module tree
evidence: Pinned GS101 and Nura commits fetched on the Linux builder; all 38 patches applied successfully.
Pinned GS101 panfrost_mmu.c matches G15 baseline SHA-256 57f03c626bdef56726bbe14ea6fd36e1229761688ddfd8da6ec3b5ec2851e1b2.
First configuration trial stopped at the gate: SIMPLE_ONDEMAND resolves to y, so the earlier m requirement was wrong. Corrected fragment and checker to y.
R2 compiled Image and Wi-Fi/CPIF modules but failed in AoC GCC-incompatible enum syntax and floating assignment.
R6 complete build passed (82.32 seconds incremental); exact touch/AoC source gates and all five artifact checksums passed.
Changed touch and AoC targets passed W=1; existing vendor warnings remain. Local touch/AoC patch checkpatch --strict: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 checks.
See gs101-build-r6-evidence.json for hashes and remaining boot gates.
Mac4 SSH responds and USB ACM enumerates; both the old phone SSH address and a bounded serial command did not respond on 2026-10-28.
Linux builder uses cross GCC 11.4 in an isolated source/output directory; no phone partitions modified.
limitations: Phone responsiveness and its running kernel cannot currently be established
A compiled driver does not prove hardware support, firmware provisioning, SIM registration or captured frames
exit_gate: Build and verify the complete kernel/modules output before preparing a recovery image; no unattended radio or PMIC probe on an unresponsive phone.
